before.reason: The musical heading and David attribution are preserved; a repeated generic title alone does not receive a separate substantive connection.

after.reason: The heading concerning the eighth and the David attribution are preserved; a repeated generic title alone does not receive a separate substantive connection.

before.reason: Preservation from this generation and for ever remains a prayer of protection; no more particular additional counterpart is retained beyond that common request.

after.reason: The assurance that the Lord will keep and preserve us from this generation and for ever is preserved; no more particular additional counterpart is retained beyond that common assurance of protection.

before.reason: The Lord’s understanding and kidneys disciplining the speaker until night remain exact; no definite prophetic revelation or outside identity for that inward discipline is supplied.

after.reason: The understanding given by the Lord and the kidneys’ discipline until night remain exact; no definite prophetic revelation or outside identity for that inward discipline is supplied.

before.reason: The first clause says that the addressed person’s hand may be found by enemies, before the right hand finds haters. Neither the direction of the first action nor the unspecified addressee is replaced by familiar wording.

after.reason: The first clause asks that the addressed person’s hand be found by enemies; the second asks that the right hand find all who hate the addressee. Neither the direction of the first action nor the unspecified addressee is replaced by familiar wording.
